about: Central Park. Moves the character at index 0 next to the start and adds a greeter that reuses character 43 and actor image 6 (the ones the stage's own characters at indexes 3 to 6 use). The greeter's last talk sets the mod flag stage-npc:met and gives 100 BIT (the port action "give-money"); the talk before it only holds once that flag is set, so the second visit gets another line and no money. The lines are named texts of this mod (text/<lang>/stages.json, "text": "stage-npc:<name>"). It also adds an exit (a rectangle of the map east of the start that leads to stage 380, press cross on it) and a tiny scripted event, "stage-npc:thanks", that the greeter's welcome talk starts (one message box, own text). Two more characters stand beside the start (one to the west, one to the east) (S9, docs/stages.md section 11): the "visitor" is character 75, one Central Park does not load (it belongs to stage 380), and with no "image" it gets a VRAM slot of its own; the "rival" is the mod sprite stage-npc:rival (sprites/rival/: a green copy of the player's sprite, generated by pc/examples/install_examples.sh from your own exported data, with its sprite.json), which is also a character of its own.
